title: Resort Club Memberships — Schedule of Initiation Fees and Admission Requirements
content:
Every level of Resort Club Memberships carries a one-time initiation fee, a minimum age for the primary member and a limit on the number of memberships of that level each resort accepts. The figures below apply at every Ashbury resort that offers the level.

## Schedule

| Membership level | Initiation fee (USD, charged once on joining) | Minimum age of the primary member | Member capacity per resort | Sponsorship by an existing member required | Other admission requirement | First month's dues prorated from the start date |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fitness Club Membership | 250.00 | 18 | 1200 | No | — | Yes |
| Pool & Fitness Club Membership | 500.00 | 18 | 900 | No | — | Yes |
| Spa Club Membership | 750.00 | 21 | 400 | No | — | Yes |
| Beach & Pool Club Membership | 1500.00 | 18 | 350 | No | — | Yes |
| Family Resort Club Membership | 2500.00 | 21 | 300 | No | Dependants registered on the membership | Yes |
| Founders Resort Club Membership | 7500.00 | 21 | 120 | Yes | — | Yes |

## Reading the columns

- **Initiation fee** — the one-time fee invoiced on joining the level, in US dollars.
- **Minimum age of the primary member** — the youngest age, in whole years, at which a person may be the primary member of the level.
- **Member capacity per resort** — the most memberships of that level a single resort accepts.
- **Sponsorship** — "Yes" means the application must be sponsored by an existing member of the same club; only the Founders Resort Club Membership carries this requirement.
- **Other admission requirement** — admission to the Family Resort Club Membership requires dependants registered on the membership; no other level carries this requirement.
- **First month's dues prorated** — "Yes" means the dues of the first month are prorated from the start date; this is "Yes" at every level.

## Points read from the schedule

- The Spa Club Membership, the Family Resort Club Membership and the Founders Resort Club Membership set the minimum age of the primary member at 21; the other three levels set it at 18.
- Capacity is counted level by level and resort by resort: the 120 Founders Resort Club Memberships a resort accepts are separate from the 300 Family Resort Club Memberships the same resort accepts.
- The initiation fee rises with the level, from 250.00 for the Fitness Club Membership to 7500.00 for the Founders Resort Club Membership.
